migrations.imported_history: patchbay.help's release (lib/patchbay/release.ex, @imported_through 20260904074137) does not skip the early versions: it refuses to migrate an area other than public until every version up to that one is already in the area's ledger, and refuses to roll back past it, because production's patchbay_app was filled by an import of the public schema with its ledger, and the early files name public. Production's ledger therefore already holds them and nothing runs there. Here the early files that named public name the area being migrated instead (prefix()), so on a fresh database they build the same tables in patchbay_app that the import moved there, and no guard is carried.
